marta: Heads-up — OrionCloud just pushed ETD for the A100 rack by ~72h. This touches Dedicated Q3 onboarding windows. Need triage: who to notify, whether we reassign inventory, and credit exposure. @jamal @lucy
jamal: Ugh. Which PO/manifest? Any container id we can use to chase?
marta: PO 89021 / manifest MC-4487. Vendor note: 'port congestion + customs hold' — no firm sail date yet. They attached a tiny manifest snippet:```MC-4487:
  items:
    - sku: A100-40GB
      qty: 8
      status: delayed```
marta: We currently map those 8 units to 3 Dedicated customers (acme-inc, scribbleai, medsearch). If ETA slips >7d we either reassign from EU pool or offer credits. Need options.
lucy: I'll check reservation mapping in marketplace console now. If we reassign, legal+sales need to sign off on credits/commit changes. @steve finance: what's our credit buffer for reserved capacity misses?
steve: Quick back-of-envelope -> 1 week reassignment across those accounts ~= $12k revenue impact. Default credit cap per SLA is $5k without CSM approval. Send me affected account list and I'll pre-approve up to $7k pending finance review.
marta: Affected accounts: acme-inc (2 GPUs), scribbleai (3 GPUs), medsearch (3 GPUs). I'll DM the CSMs. @vendor_ops_bot any automated reassign suggestions from the marketplace scheduler?
vendor_ops_bot: Suggestion: if ETA > 5d, run staged reassign: 1) use EU surplus pool to satisfy highest-SLO customers, 2) enable hosted fallback for latency-tolerant routes, 3) offer prorated credits for affected committed capacity. Preview command: `./scripts/reservation-reshuffle --manifest MC-4487 --preview`
jamal: Run the preview and paste the output here.
lucy: Preview pasted:```preview MC-4487:
 - acme-inc: lose 2 GPUs (fallback available EU-surplus: yes)
 - scribbleai: lose 3 GPUs (hosted-fallback viable: yes, but needs opt-in)
 - medsearch: lose 3 GPUs (SLA: high, no hosted fallback allowed)```
jamal: medsearch can't use hosted fallback due to compliance — we need either reassign from another reserved pool (check APAC spare?) or negotiate delayed go-live.
marta: OK. Proposed action plan: 1) enable hosted fallback for scribbleai (with opt-in & temporary burst) 2) run a canary reassignment for acme-inc using EU-surplus 3) open credit pre-approval ticket for medsearch if we can't find spare inventory.
steve: I pre-approve up to $7k emergency credit. Finance will need the incident ticket and final numbers.
vendor_ops_bot: Running `reservation-reshuffle --manifest MC-4487 --move EU-surplus --dryrun` -> result: 2 units available for acme-inc, 0 for medsearch, 1 for scribbleai (but scribbleai prefers hosted).
lucy: Can we source 2 more units from upcoming inbound SN-502 that lands in 5 days? If yes, medsearch would still be short by 2 for >7d.
marta: We need communications: (A) notify medsearch CSM + Sales about potential 7d+ delay and credit options, (B) offer scribbleai hosted fallback with clear cost/latency tradeoff, (C) start canary for acme-inc. I'll draft emails.
steve: Include estimated $/day credit and restore plan. Finance would like a quick spreadsheet: days delayed vs credit by customer.
marta: Will attach spreadsheet to the marketplace incident ticket. @ops-oncall please watch for anomalies when we enable hosted fallback — there may be routing/regional throttles to watch.
ops-oncall: acknowledged — post the canary config and we'll monitor trace & error rates.
marta: Action ETA: hosted fallback for scribbleai in ~2h, canary reassignment for acme-inc in ~4h, medsearch comms + ticket in 1h. I'll update thread as vendor provides new ETD. Thanks everyone :pray:
